title: Introducing yourself at Delta Ducon
grammar: to be — I am / you are
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender a se apresentar no trabalho usando o verbo 'to be' nas formas I am e you are. Vai conseguir dizer o seu nome, a sua função e de onde você é — as primeiras frases que abrem qualquer conversa com colegas, clientes e visitantes na Delta Ducon.
intro: Your first day at Delta Ducon can feel big. A simple 'Hi, I am Ana, I work at Delta Ducon' opens every door.
Today we practise I am and you are with the people and places you see every day. Take your time — every sentence counts.
introAudio: Hi, I am Ana. I work at Delta Ducon. Your first day can feel big, but a simple hello opens every door.
vocab: My colleague works in the emissions division.
I am an engineer at Delta Ducon.
Our factory is in Pirapora do Bom Jesus.
My desk is near the window.
practice: I am a new ______ on the emissions team.
Ana is a new ______ from the São Paulo office.
Our ______ is in Pirapora do Bom Jesus.
He is an ______ based in Uberlândia.
She is a kind ______ from HR.

audio.title: Welcome to Delta Ducon
audio.text: Hi! I am Ricardo. I am an engineer at Delta Ducon. You are my new colleague. You are welcome here. I am happy to meet you. My desk is near the window, and your desk is right next to mine. I am sure you are going to like it here.

readAloud: I am at the Diadema factory.
qa: Yes, I am. / No, I am not.
Yes, I am happy at Delta Ducon.
sentences: I am at the Diadema factory.
grammarPoint: I am / You are. Use I am para falar de você. Use you are para falar com a outra pessoa. I am an engineer. — Eu sou um engenheiro. You are my colleague. — Você é meu colega.
deepDive: No inglês, I é sempre am, e you é sempre are. Usamos essas formas para nos apresentar, dizer de onde somos e falar da nossa função. Na dúvida, use a forma completa: I am, you are.
examples: I am at the Diadema factory.
Eu estou na fábrica de Diadema.
mistakes: A forma negativa é am not.
Não esqueça o verbo to be.

celebrate.en: Great start. Every professional who speaks English once said their very first sentence — you just said yours.
celebrate.pt: Ótimo começo. Todo profissional que fala inglês um dia disse a primeira frase — você acabou de dizer a sua.
